text: Both runs are still going. One is checking 9.A and the other is tabbing through the page. I'll start the other three pages as well.
Run status: the careers page is finished except for some open review items. The missions page is at 7 minutes, still on test 5.D. The other three pages are queued. I'll keep waiting.
Missions is still on 5.D, now at 11½ minutes. I'll check the KSC page.

I ran all five pages through the Trusted Tester tools and answered their open questions. These are agent-assisted findings, not a certified Trusted Tester result.

**Confirmed fails**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks** fails on all four pages where the check completed: careers, missions, Artemis III and KSC history. Each page starts with repeated header content ("Explore", "News & Events" and "Multimedia" buttons), and no skip link or other keyboard bypass moved focus past it. The NACA page is needs review because only the first 8 possible skip methods were tried.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions** fails on every page. The only label on the "Search" text field is the gray placeholder text, which disappears once someone types.
- **1.3.1 Info and Relationships** fails on the missions page. The "MISSION STATUS" checkboxes ("Active", "Future", "Inactive") are not grouped with their heading. Other checkbox groups on the page share names such as "Universe" and "Earth's Moon", so a screen reader user can't tell which group a checkbox belongs to.

**Needs review**
- **2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide** is needs review on every page, because the check for content that keeps changing after 5 seconds could not be performed. On the NACA page the tool also found a large area that changes about every 0.4 seconds, plus seven pulsing icons. I didn't open the images, so I answered "unsure" on whether that motion is essential.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible** is needs review on every page. Many elements could not be seen in the before and after pictures, and I couldn't judge the dark crops. The tool's FAIL on Artemis III and NACA lists only elements it couldn't see, with no confirmed failing element.
- **2.4.3 Focus Order** is needs review on careers, missions, Artemis III and NACA. I only judged KSC to preserve a sensible order, and I could have misjudged some jumps (for example the footer on KSC).
- **2.4.5 Multiple Ways:** the tool found the site search as the only way to reach the careers, Artemis III, NACA and KSC pages, and no way to reach the missions page. It still marks the result as needs review.
- **3.2.2 On Input:** on the missions page, changing the filter checkboxes changes the page address, and nothing tells the user in advance. I wasn't sure this counts as a change of context, so I left it needs review.
- **Form checks (1.3.1, 2.4.6, 4.1.2, 3.3.1, 3.3.3)** are needs review on several pages. The causes were form fields inside frames that were not checked, a form attempt that could not complete, and a server response that can't be seen in the recording. On the missions page only the first 60 of 101 form fields were checked.
- **2.1.1 Keyboard** is needs review on Artemis III and NACA, because the Tab walk could not finish. 3.2.1 On Focus is needs review on careers and Artemis III, because focus jumped once but not on retry.

I reported 2.4.6 as needs review on careers and KSC, where the tool said it doesn't apply. The only field there has just a placeholder, and I wasn't sure a placeholder counts as no label.

I gave 4.1.2 the same result as the tool's combined 1.3.1/4.1.2 check. On missions I left it needs review rather than infer from the 1.3.1 fail.
